text:
maya: Quick design huddle — posted a small Figma update for the autoscale controls. Need eyes on: burst flow wording, min/max stepper affordance, pool-selection chips, and the SLO guardrail microcopy. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/autoscale-v2 :eyes: kevin: diving in now. first glance — the burst label is a little terse. users might think it's a toggle rather than a temporary quota. maybe "Burst capacity (temporary)"? :thinking_face: olivia: +1 to clarifying temporary. Also the helper text should call out billing/limits. Something like: "Temporary GPUs for short bursts — billed at on-demand rates." sam: saw a usability test yesterday — 1/5 testers clicked the mini info icon and expected a dropdown. They didn't see that burst is per-pool. we should add explicit pool-scoped copy under the chip when a pool is preselected. jordan: on the min/max stepper: keyboard users reported hitting arrow keys but the value jumped too far. Suggest step=1 and include aria-live region for updates so screen readers announce new capacity. Also visible focus ring is a bit thin (4px recommended). maya: good catches. can we draft precise copy options? I'll list current strings and proposed replacements: - Current: "Min" / "Max" - Proposal: "Min reserved GPUs" / "Max burstable GPUs" kevin: prefer "Min reserved GPUs" but "Max burstable GPUs" reads odd. What about "Max (including burst)"? shorter: "Max capacity (incl. burst)" olivia: accessibility nit: contrast for the disabled stepper label falls below 3:1 on smaller font sizes. We need to bump to AA. Also ensure the stepper has aria-label="Minimum reserved GPUs" when it's focused. maya: noted. jordan — can you paste the snippet for aria? jordan: sure — quick example: ```html
Min reserved GPUs updated to 4
``` kevin: perfect. also, the pool-selection chips — right now they only show name and region. I worry that different GPU types look identical. add a small badge (e.g. "A100") and use a subtle icon to denote GPU family. sam: +1. testers confused between "general" and "compute" pools. badge will help. Also, when a chosen pool doesn't support burst, the burst control should be disabled and show tooltip: "Burst unavailable on selected pool" not just greyed out. maya: add to acceptance criteria: disabled state must include tooltip and be keyboard accessible. design-bot: accessibility checklist reminder: ensure all interactive controls have keyboard focus, 4.5:1 contrast for body text, 3:1 for UI components, and role/aria attributes on composite controls. olivia: SLO slider copy — current label "SLO" is too terse. Call it out as "Latency SLO (p90)" with a hover tooltip: "Target 90th percentile latency. Adjusting lower may increase cost." jordan: suggest guardrail microcopy for extreme low SLO values: "Setting SLO below 200ms may cause high cost or require more reserved capacity. We'll suggest a min guardrail at 50ms and show estimated cost delta." kevin: how should we surface estimated cost? inline small secondary text under SLO slider: "Est. +$0.12/min when set to 100ms" or a preview modal for bigger changes? maya: prefer inline for quick decisions, modal for >20% cost impact. keep inline text concise and link to detailed estimator. sam: copy tweak: change "Burst" tooltip from "Short term capacity" to "Short-term capacity burst (billed separately) — ideal for spiky traffic." olivia: small UX flow: when user changes pool via dropdown, if current min/max violate pool quotas we should surface a non-blocking inline validation: orange banner: "Selected pool max GPUs is 8; your Max (15) exceeds this. We'll suggest compatible values." include suggested buttons: "Apply suggestion" / "Keep as-is". Keyboard focus should go to banner when it appears. jordan: acceptance: banner must have role="alert" so screen readers are notified. keep messaging concise. maya: decision list for next patch: 1) Update labels: "Min reserved GPUs", "Max capacity (incl. burst)", "Latency SLO (p90)" 2) Add GPU family badge on pool chips and region tag 3) Improve stepper accessibility (step=1, aria labels, visible focus) 4) Disabled burst -> tooltip + keyboard focusable 5) Inline estimated cost copy for small deltas, modal for large 6) Validation banner when pool quotas conflict (role="alert") 7) Update contrast to meet AA as noted by olivia kevin: timeline? can we ship a1 with 3,4,6,7 this week and 1,2,5 next sprint? maya: yes — I'll prioritize a1. Kevin/jordan — can you pair on the stepper/ARIA PR? olivia — can you run quick contrast pass and mock up banner text? sam — i'll need a short note for QA about the test case where pool switch keeps legacy values. sam: got it. will add test cases. olivia: will post contrast screenshots in the thread by EOD. :thumbsup: kevin: pairing now, will open draft PR and link it. :rocket: maya: thanks team! small followup — adding a11y checklist to the Figma file under "notes" so reviewers can tick off items. :white_check_mark: design-bot: Reminder: deploy checklist updated — please link PR to the board and add the a11y tag for release review.
